items.summary: Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said Monday evening the group targeted King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh with a ballistic missile, claiming the strike was "precise," and launched a drone attack on King Khalid Air Base in Khamis Mushait, claiming a "direct hit." He renewed warnings to airlines, employees and travellers to avoid Saudi airports and airspace (except Mecca and Medina). The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted and destroyed the Riyadh-bound missile; explosions were heard in the capital, residents received mobile alerts, and Civil Defense later said the danger had passed.
items.title: Saree claims new Monday-evening ballistic-missile strike on Riyadh airport; coalition says it intercepted the missile

items.summary: Saudi-led coalition airstrikes on the government complex and a citizen's home in the Khabb wa ash-Shaaf district of Al-Jawf governorate killed 9 people, including five children and a woman, and injured seven others, according to the Houthi-run health ministry. Houthi-run al-Masirah TV independently reported the same toll of nine killed and seven injured. Both sources are Houthi-affiliated; the claims could not be independently verified.
items.title: 9 killed (incl. 5 children, 1 woman), 7 injured in Saudi-led airstrikes on Al-Jawf, Yemen

items.summary: At his weekly press conference on Monday, Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei reiterated that Tehran stands ready to facilitate dialogue between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis, a diplomatic overture as regional and international concern over the escalation mounts.
items.title: Iran reiterates readiness to facilitate dialogue between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis

items.summary: Yemeni military spokesperson Majid al-Nuzaili claimed government forces had carried out 1,879 attacks on Houthi military targets in recent hours, saying about 950 Houthi fighters had been "neutralized." Single-sourced claim; no independent verification reported.
items.title: Yemeni government claims 1,879 strikes on Houthi targets, ~950 fighters "neutralized"
